code: Ontario Building Code, Sentence 9.23.12.3.(1) lintel tables (Table A-15 series; renumbered 9.23.12.3.-A to -D in the 2024 Code)
scope_of_this_tool: SPF No. 1 or No. 2, non-structural sheathing, 2-ply lintels, supporting ROOF AND CEILING ONLY (supported joist/rafter span not more than 4.9 m). This is the subset that could be verified from readable public sources.
not_included: 3-ply lintels, roof + ceiling + storeys conditions, limited-attic-storage conditions and structural-sheathing variants exist in the Code tables but could not be verified from a readable public source; they are deliberately excluded rather than guessed.
applicability_9_23_12_3_1: Wall studs exceed 38 x 64 mm. (In loadbearing walls framed with 38 x 64 mm members, lintels shall be not less than 50 mm deeper than the tabled size and not more than 2.24 m long.)
Spans of supported joists do not exceed 4.9 m; spans of supported trusses do not exceed 9.8 m.
columns: exterior wall, specified snow load 1.0 kPa
provenance: Subset read from the Table A-15 excerpt reproduced in the CSA Z240.2.1 technical requirements paper and cross-checked against the City of Niagara Falls accessory-structures guide citing the same OBC table (2-38x89 at SSL 2.0 = 1.01 m; 2-38x286 exterior 2.56 m / interior 2.33 m — both match), and a 2024 Ontario permit lintel schedule of the same magnitude.
